brief.title: EV Charging Network Performance & Grid Optimization Analytics Report
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of EV charging station operations, demand patterns, grid load dynamics, and optimization opportunities across a smart-grid charging network.
brief.goal: Equip infrastructure managers and grid planners with data-driven insights into station utilization, queue bottlenecks, renewable energy integration, pricing impacts, and actionable recommendations to improve charging throughput, reduce wait times, and optimize grid load balancing.

required_sections.title: Station Utilization & Demand Analysis
required_sections.objective: Analyze charging demand distribution across stations and location types (Urban, Highway, Suburban), identifying high-demand stations, peak utilization periods, and capacity constraints.

required_sections.title: Queue Length & Waiting Time Analysis
required_sections.objective: Examine queue lengths and waiting times by station, time slot, vehicle type, and traffic density to identify bottleneck patterns and quantify the customer experience impact.

required_sections.title: Energy Consumption & Grid Load Patterns
required_sections.objective: Assess energy consumption patterns, station load profiles across time slots and days of the week, and the relationship between charging power levels and grid stress.

required_sections.title: Renewable Energy Integration & Dynamic Pricing
required_sections.objective: Evaluate the renewable energy ratio across different conditions (time, weather, location) and analyze how dynamic electricity pricing correlates with demand, renewable availability, and optimization rewards.

required_sections.title: Vehicle Charging Behavior & Session Profiles
required_sections.objective: Profile charging sessions by vehicle type, examining battery capacity, initial/final SOC, energy consumed, charging duration, and priority distribution to understand fleet composition and usage patterns.

required_sections.title: Optimization Insights & Recommendations
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for load balancing, queue management, pricing strategy adjustments, and renewable energy maximization, leveraging the optimization reward metric as a performance signal.

kpis.name: Average Waiting Time
kpis.description: Mean time (in minutes) vehicles spend in queue before charging begins, segmented by time slot and location type.

kpis.name: Average Energy Consumed per Session
kpis.description: Mean energy transferred (kWh) per charging session, indicating typical session intensity.

kpis.name: Mean Station Load
kpis.description: Average electrical load on station local grids, as an indicator of grid stress levels.

kpis.name: Renewable Energy Ratio
kpis.description: Average proportion of grid energy sourced from renewables, measuring sustainability performance.

kpis.name: Mean Optimization Reward
kpis.description: Average synthetic reward metric across sessions, serving as a composite indicator of grid optimization effectiveness.
